subject: general
question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Curtailed
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 2' **i.e. **'Lengthened'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to** 'curtailed'** is option 2)** 'lengthened'.**
 
• **'Curtailed'** means to cut short or reduce in extent or quantity; to restrict. (कटौती किया हुआ)
 
• Therefore, its antonym would be something that means to increase or extend.
 
• **'Lengthened' **- Make or become longer (बढ़ाया हुआ).

Therefore, the **correct answer** is:** 'Lengthened'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Here are the meanings of all the words in English and Hindi:
 
 
• **'Slashed'** - Cut (something) with a violent sweeping movement (कटा हुआ).
 
• **'Pruned' **- Trim (a tree, shrub, or bush) by cutting away dead or overgrown branches or stems, especially to increase fruitfulness and growth (छांटा हुआ).
 
• **'Trimmed' **- Made (something) neat or of the required size or form by cutting away irregular or unwanted parts (काटकर सजाया हुआ).
